display.purpose: Two-line hero headline only, lines masked for the intro.

title.purpose: Loupe detail titles and spec group heads.

small.purpose: Labels, nav links, form messages, spec terms, footer.

label.purpose: Ref. RM-01 and detail reference numbers; spec values use the same face at 0.8125rem.

shadows.name: header-rule
shadows.purpose: Hairline under the header once it turns solid. A rule, not elevation.

shadows.name: focus-underline
shadows.purpose: Doubles the waitlist input underline on focus.

shadows.name: quiet-outline
shadows.purpose: Outline of the quieted header CTA.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Header ground, link underline draw, loupe title colour.

motion.name: intro
motion.value: GSAP timeline, expo.out; media 1.8s, scale wipe 1.4s power3.inOut, headline lines 1.2s stagger 0.1s
motion.purpose: The single page-load sequence; skipped for reduced motion or hidden tabs.

motion.name: loupe-scrub
motion.value: pin 3.4 viewport heights, scrub 0.7, snap labelsDirectional 0.25-0.7s power2.inOut
motion.purpose: The only scroll-driven motion, in the macro explorer.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The crimson action: waitlist submit, Reserve a pair.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--crimson, #d71920); color: var(--porcelain, #f8f8f6); font: 600 1rem/1 var(--f-serif, 'Bodoni Moda Variable', Didot, serif); letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--crimson-deep, #b3141a); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--crimson, #d71920); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet Header Button
components.description: Header Reserve CTA while the hero form is on screen; crimson steps back.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1.125rem; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--graphite, #242424); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--graphite, #242424); font: 600 0.9375rem/1 var(--f-serif, 'Bodoni Moda Variable', Didot, serif); letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--graphite, #242424); color: var(--porcelain, #f8f8f6); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--crimson, #d71920); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Waitlist Form
components.description: Underline-only email field with the primary button on the same baseline.
components.html: Price and release note.
components.css: .ds-waitlist { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; grid-template-areas: 'label label' 'input button' 'msg msg'; align-items: end; max-width: 34rem; font-family: var(--f-serif, 'Bodoni Moda Variable', Didot, serif); } .ds-waitlist-label { grid-area: label; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink-2, #5a5a57); margin-bottom: 0.25rem; } .ds-waitlist-input { grid-area: input; min-width: 0; height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1rem 0 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--graphite, #242424); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--graphite, #242424); font: 400 1.125rem/1 inherit; font-family: inherit; caret-color: var(--crimson, #d71920); } .ds-waitlist-input::placeholder { color: #7a7a76; } .ds-waitlist-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-bottom-color: var(--crimson, #d71920); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--crimson, #d71920); } .ds-waitlist-btn { grid-area: button; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--crimson, #d71920); color: var(--porcelain, #f8f8f6); font: 600 1rem/1 inherit; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-waitlist-btn:hover { background: var(--crimson-deep, #b3141a); } .ds-waitlist-msg { grid-area: msg; margin: 0.75rem 0 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--ink-2, #5a5a57); }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Wordmark, mono reference after a hairline, links with draw-in underline.
components.html: Red MediciRef. RM-01DesignSpecs
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; height: 4.5rem; padding: 0 2rem; background: var(--porcelain, #f8f8f6); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--rule, #cfcfcb); font-family: var(--f-serif, 'Bodoni Moda Variable', Didot, serif); color: var(--graphite, #242424); } .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.625rem; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-ref { margin-right: auto; padding-left: 1.5rem; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule, #cfcfcb); font: 400 0.75rem/1.5 var(--f-mono, 'Martian Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); color: var(--ink-2, #5a5a57); } .ds-nav-link { font-size: 0.9375rem; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 2px; background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) 0 100% / 0 1px no-repeat; transition: background-size 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { background-size: 100% 1px; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--crimson, #d71920); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Minute-Track Scale
components.description: Hero timeline: 60 fine ticks, every fifth longer, with a crimson hand tracking video time.
components.css: .ds-scale { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 14px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, rgb(36 36 36 / 0.55) 0 1px, transparent 1px calc(100% / 60)) 0 100% / 100% 6px no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(to right, rgb(36 36 36 / 0.55) 0 1px, transparent 1px calc(100% / 12)) 0 100% / 100% 14px no-repeat; } .ds-scale-hand { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 2px; height: 20px; background: var(--crimson, #d71920); animation: ds-sweep 8s linear infinite; } .ds-scale:hover .ds-scale-hand { animation-play-state: paused; } @keyframes ds-sweep { to { left: calc(100% - 2px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-scale-hand { animation: none; } }

components.name: Loupe Frame with Rulers
components.description: 3:2 porcelain window with tick rulers top and left; crimson ticks mark the focal coordinate.
components.css: .ds-loupe { position: relative; padding: 18px 0 0 18px; width: 100%; max-width: 32rem; } .ds-loupe-window { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; background: var(--plate, #e9e9e7); overflow: hidden; } .ds-ruler-x, .ds-ruler-y { position: absolute; } .ds-ruler-x { top: 0; left: 18px; right: 0; height: 12px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, #242424 0 1px, transparent 1px 1.25%) 0 100% / 100% 5px no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(to right, #242424 0 1px, transparent 1px 6.25%) 0 100% / 100% 12px no-repeat; } .ds-ruler-y { top: 18px; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 12px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, #242424 0 1px, transparent 1px 1.875%) 100% 0 / 5px 100% no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, #242424 0 1px, transparent 1px 9.375%) 100% 0 / 12px 100% no-repeat; } .ds-ruler-x span, .ds-ruler-y span { position: absolute; background: var(--crimson, #d71920); transition: left 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), top 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-ruler-x span { bottom: 0; width: 2px; height: 16px; } .ds-ruler-y span { right: 0; width: 16px; height: 2px; } .ds-reticle { position: absolute; width: 72px; height: 72px; margin: -36px 0 0 -36px; border: 1px solid rgb(36 36 36 / 0.7); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-loupe:hover .ds-ruler-x span { left: 30% !important; } .ds-loupe:hover .ds-ruler-y span { top: 65% !important; }

components.name: Spec Sheet Rows
components.description: Definition rows on the graphite case back: serif term, mono tabular value, hairline rules.
components.css: .ds-specs { padding: 2rem; background: var(--graphite, #242424); color: var(--porcelain, #f8f8f6); font-family: var(--f-serif, 'Bodoni Moda Variable', Didot, serif); } .ds-specs h3 { margin: 0 0 1rem; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-specs dl { margin: 0; } .ds-specs dl > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr); gap: 1rem; padding: 0.9rem 0; border-top: 1px solid rgb(248 248 246 / 0.16); } .ds-specs dl > div:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(248 248 246 / 0.16); } .ds-specs dl > div:hover dd { color: var(--porcelain, #f8f8f6); } .ds-specs dt { color: var(--on-dark-2, #b9b9b5); font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-specs dd { margin: 0; font: 400 0.8125rem/1.7 var(--f-mono, 'Martian Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The earbud is presented the way a haute-horlogerie manufacture presents a new movement: one object, a reference number (Ref. RM-01), macro plates of the real photo, and a sheet of exact figures. The ground is a porcelain dial, the plates are light grey, the ink is graphite, and one section turns over to a graphite "case back" for the specifications.

Crimson behaves like a seconds hand. It marks the one thing that is active right now (the primary CTA, the sweeping hand on the minute track, the focal tick on a ruler, the active reference, focus) and nothing else. The minute-track scale, fine ticks with every fifth one longer, is the structural device: hero timeline, loupe rulers, hairline section rules.

Density is low and deliberate: generous section padding, a 12-column grid, square corners, 1px rules. Rejected: the dark neon esports page, the split hero over feature cards, gradients, glass, glows, rounding, fake 3D.
keyCharacteristics: Porcelain, plate and graphite surfaces with a single crimson accent for the active state.
High-contrast Didone (Bodoni Moda, optical sizing) for all prose; mono only for references and measured values.
Minute-track tick scales as the recurring structural motif.
Square corners, hairline 1px rules, no shadows.
Real product imagery only, multiplied onto its ground.

rules.name: The Seconds-Hand Rule
rules.body: Crimson marks only the active element. When two crimson actions would share a viewport, one steps back: the header CTA turns into a graphite outline while the hero waitlist form is on screen.

rules.name: The One Case Back Rule
rules.body: Graphite as a ground is used for exactly one section, the specification sheet. Everything else sits on porcelain or plate.

rules.name: The Measured-Value Rule
rules.body: Mono is for references and figures only. Never set a sentence, heading or button in mono.

rules.name: The No-Caps Rule
rules.body: Nothing is uppercased or letter-spaced for emphasis; hierarchy comes from size and the Didone's contrast.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If something needs separating, give it a 1px rule, never a blur.

dos: Do keep crimson to one active element per viewport; quiet any competing CTA to a graphite outline.
Do use the minute-track tick scale (every fifth tick longer) for rulers, timelines and measured indices.
Do set references and measured figures in Martian Mono with tabular numerals, and everything else in Bodoni Moda.
Do separate with 1px rules (rule on light, rule-dark on graphite) and keep every corner square.
Do multiply real product photography onto plate or porcelain grounds.
Do give every motion a reduced-motion fallback: static plates, a paused video, no intro.
donts: Don't use crimson for decoration, headings or backgrounds; the wordmark glyph is the one fixed brand exception.
Don't add shadows, gradients, glass, glows, blobs or rounded corners.
Don't set prose, headings or buttons in mono, or uppercase anything for emphasis.
Don't use graphite as a section ground beyond the single specification sheet.
Don't add scroll-driven motion outside the loupe, or a second load sequence.
Don't build fake 3D renders or a feature-card grid.
